title: Midnight niche starter kits: six variants as data on lib/sites/kits (coaches, studios, hosts, venues, nonprofits, networks)

source.ref: Mega Theme lead assignment 2026-10-26: build Midnight's six niche variants on the Midnight block family, generic sample copy in the voice guide with slot tokens, no real names or prices, one model with lib/sites/kits.

detail: Six kits for the Midnight mega theme, one per niche door, each 3 to 5 pages of Midnight blocks and live Space blocks. Pure data: generic placeholder copy in the house voice (docs/marketing/voice-and-language-guide.md), {{slot|sample}} tokens for facts a Space already stores, no prices, no photos, no real names. Same SiteKit model and lazy registry as the Wildheart kit, so the public site never imports them. A test checks every block is registered, the applied site validates with registry defaults, copy holds no prices or photos, and every internal link lands on a page of the same kit or a platform page. Not built here: the editor panel that applies a kit (next row), a picker, a switcher.

verify.evidence: Six kits and 11 tests in lib/sites/kits/kits.test.ts pass locally.
